# Tollkit

> Pay-per-call tools for AI agents, paid per call in USDC with x402 on Base or Solana. No account, no API key. Web pages, PDFs and search; SEC filings and due diligence; US weather, airport delays, geocoding, IP lookup and exchange rates; wallets, token prices and token checks on Base, Ethereum and Solana; product prices; signed page proofs. Failed calls are never charged.

## Start here

- MCP: add https://extract.tollkit.dev/mcp as a remote MCP server. A paid tool called without `payment` returns its price quote; pay it with your x402 wallet and call again.
- HTTP: every tool, its URL, body and price: https://extract.tollkit.dev/llms.txt
- OpenAPI: https://extract.tollkit.dev/openapi.json
- Agent skill: `npx skills add https://tollkit.dev`
